issues.description: In the problem statement, Part 2.4 asks for a method named getTotalStudents() and references a getTotalStudentsTest(), but the UML diagram and the provided solution use the name getTotalNumberOfStudents() (and related methods call getTotalNumberOfStudents()). This inconsistency can lead students to implement the wrong method name and fail tests expecting the other name.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one method name and use it consistently across the task text, UML, tests, template TODOs, and solution. Recommended: update the task text (and any referenced test name) to require getTotalNumberOfStudents() to match the UML/solution.
